chunks: My father and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Ḥasan ibn Mattīl, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Abī Hāshim Al-Ja’fari, who said:

Abul Ḥasan (Imam Hādi (a.s.)) sent for me during his illness and also for Muḥammad ibn Ḥamzah. Muḥammad ibn Ḥamzah arrived before me and informed me that the Imam kept saying, 'Send someone to the Ḥā`ir.' I said to Muḥammad, 'Why did you not say that I would go to the Ḥā`ir?' Then I entered upon the Imam and said to him, 'May I be sacrificed for you! I will go to the Ḥā`ir.' He replied, 'Consider this matter carefully, for Muḥammad does not keep secrets from Zayd ibn ‘Ali, and I dislike for him to hear about this.' I mentioned this to ‘Ali ibn Bilāl, who asked, 'What does the Ḥā`ir have to do with him, while he himself is the Ḥā`ir?' I returned to ‘Askar and entered upon the Imam. He said to me, 'Sit,' when I was about to rise. When he saw that I was comfortable, I mentioned what ‘Ali ibn Bilāl had said. So he said to me, 'Why did you not tell him that the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) used to circumambulate the House and kiss the Stone, and the sanctity of the Prophet (s.a.a.w.) and the believer is greater than the sanctity of the House? And Allāh commanded him to stand at ‘Arafāt. These are merely places in which Allāh loves to be remembered. And I love to have someone pray for me in a place where Allāh loves to be prayed in, and the Ḥā`ir is one of those places.'

key_terms.الْحَائِر: The Hā'ir, a specific sacred location known for prayer

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Hadi (a.s.) send someone to the Hā'ir for prayer on his behalf?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* elucidates the theological distinction between the intrinsic sanctity of the Imam and the ritual significance of specific geographical locations. Imam al-Hadi (a.s.) clarifies that while the Prophet’s and Imam’s honor surpasses that of the Kaaba, he chooses to be remembered in places like al-Hā’ir because they are divinely appointed sites where God loves to be invoked, thereby linking physical pilgrimage to spiritual presence.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan both narrated to me from Ḥasan ibn Mattīl, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Abī Hāshim Al-Ja’fari, who said:

When Abul Ḥasan (Imam Hādi (a.s.)) was ill, he sent for Muḥammad ibn Ḥamzah and I. Muḥammad ibn Ḥamzah arrived there before I did and told me that the Imam (a.s.) kept saying, “Send someone (on my behalf) to the Ḥā`ir. Send someone (on my behalf) to the Ḥā`ir.” I said to Muḥammad ibn Ḥamzah, “Why did you not say that you would go to the Ḥā`ir (on his behalf)?!” Then I went to the Imam (a.s.) and said, “May I sacrifice myself for you! I will go to the Ḥā`ir.” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Plan it carefully, for Muḥammad cannot keep this matter hidden from Zayd ibn ‘Ali and I do not want him to find out about this.” I mentioned this to ‘Ali ibn Bilāl and he asked, “Why does the Imam (a.s.) want to send someone to the Ḥā`ir while he is (as sacred as) the Ḥā`ir?!” I went back to ‘Askar (Sāmarrā) and went to visit the Imam (a.s.). When I was about to leave, the Imam (a.s.) asked me to stay. Once I felt comfortable, I mentioned that which ‘Ali ibn Bilāl had said. Therefore, the Imam (a.s.) said: Why did you not reply to him by saying that the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) used to circulate the Ka’bah and kiss the Ḥajar (Al-Aswad) even though the sanctity of the Prophet (s.a.a.w.) and even a believer is greater than the sanctity of the House (of Allāh)?! (Moreover), Allāh ordered him (the Prophet (s.a.a.w.)) to go to ‘Arafāt and stay in it (while he is more sacred than ‘Arafāt). (This is because) these are places in which Allāh loves to be called upon. And I love to have someone pray for me in a place where Allāh loves to be called upon, and the Ḥā`ir is one of these places.
